purpose: Second arm of catalogue row 13 ('TabPFN-3 vs 2.6, matched protocol'). The v2.6 arm closed CLOSE (standalone 0.956951, port_delta_v7 -1.051e-3, CI entirely below zero). Row 13's method requires the v3 checkpoint too; the champion itself uses v3.5, so v3 is the direct-predecessor arm and the only remaining structurally distinct TabPFN-class candidate in the endgame budget.

checkpoint.note: the repo ships 4 classifier checkpoints (binary / multiclass / ood / default); the DEFAULT one is used so the arm matches the v2.6 arm's single-checkpoint geometry
checkpoint.license: TabPFN Non-Commercial License v1.0; 'Data Science Competitions' explicitly included (text verified in artifacts/tabpfn3/LICENSE); competition-eligible

matched_protocol.identical_to: the v2.6 arm (P20-ENDGAME-TABPFN26-SCREEN + amendment A1) with ONLY model_path differing
matched_protocol.fit_rows: stratified 100,000 rows from the FIT rows of primary fold 0 -- THE SAME CONTEXT BOUND the v2.6 arm required after its full-context OOM, so the two arms are directly comparable; the bound is disclosed in every claim
matched_protocol.params: n_estimators=1, fit_mode=fit_with_cache, kv_cache_precision=int8, keep_cache_on_device=True, inference_precision=autocast, memory_saving_mode=True, random_state=1201, ignore_pretraining_limits=True, batch 1024, gpu_memory_fraction 0.85, categorical indices from the route view
matched_protocol.icl_bf16: used if and only if the checkpoint's model class exposes enable_icl_bf16 (recorded either way; never assumed)

measured: port_delta_v7 vs the true v7 champion (0.9618278142504795)
Spearman + logit Pearson vs v7 and route_ref

frozen_decision_rule.PROMOTE_to_5fold_OOF: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of port_delta_v7 > 0 AND spearman(v3, v7) < 0.995 AND standalone >= 0.960457
frozen_decision_rule.CLOSE: paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of port_delta_v7 <= 0
frozen_decision_rule.AMBIGUOUS: CI straddles 0 without satisfying PROMOTE -- recorded, NOT promoted
frozen_decision_rule.note: identical to the v2.6 arm's rule; the threshold is not moved between arms

secondary_observation_rule: If the v3 arm screens CLOSE, the optional multi-checkpoint internal ensemble (the repo's 4 classifier checkpoints as 4 internal contexts) is NOT run: it would be a new experiment requiring its own prereg and would have to beat a closed decision, so it stays available but unbudgeted unless this arm shows the v3 family is competitive.
